text_block_list.text:
A crowd had gathered by the track I 
happened to pass by. And there—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The race is about to start. Quiet down.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I got dragged into this by the 
President.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's a promotional event to show the charm 
of racing to folks who've never seen one.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, why on earth am I the one 
acting as the guide...

text_block_list.name: Male Customer
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Hey there, fellow Umamusume! You're 
running too, right? I'll be cheering you 
on with all my might~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "No need. Just watch in silence."

text_block_list.name: Male Customer
text_block_list.text: Eek! I-Is that so... I'm so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So what?

text_block_list.name: Female Customer
text_block_list.text:
What is that... awful. To think a 
delinquent like that is running too.

text_block_list.name: Female Customer
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you normally supposed to 'run with 
the cheers at your back'? ...Not that 
there's any oddball who'd cheer for me 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ... Let them chirp all they want.

text_block_list.name: Female Customer
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What?! ...You're calling my thoughtful 
warning 'chirping'?! Fine then, I'm going 
home—eek?!
(Thud)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: !? Hey!

text_block_list.name: Female Customer
text_block_list.text:
J-Just leave me alone! It's only a minor 
ankle sprain—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Shut up. Hurry up and put your arm over my 
shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
No swelling. Taping's done too. ...How's 
the pain?

text_block_list.name: Female Customer
text_block_list.text:
None, really. ......You're pretty handy, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I make sure to be careful about 
injuries. Missing out on races is the last 
thing I want.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Besides—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Besides, having those "curious fans of 
mine" fussing and worrying over me is a 
real pain.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...All they need to do is keep their eyes 
fixed on my back.

text_block_list.name: Female Customer
text_block_list.text: ...!! S-So... so cool...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, what are you spacing out for? 
Hurry up and get to the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Or... would you rather a 'delinquent' 
carry you to the hospital?"

text_block_list.name: Female Customer
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaah! N-N-No way! My heart couldn't 
take it, so I'm fine...!

text_block_list.name: Female Customer
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! Thank you very much! I'll definitely 
make a full recovery and come cheer you 
on~~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Cheering for me? ...Didn't she hate 
my guts?
choice_data_list: Maybe I was moved by how cool it was.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Cheering for me? ...Didn't she hate 
my guts?
choice_data_list: Maybe I was moved by how cool it was.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Coolness? ...Now I understand even less. 
They ought to fear me, not yearn for me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ... ...Is that your kind of hobby?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ......Hey. Stop laughing this instant.

I got glared at... but it was so endearing 
that I couldn't stop chuckling for a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Hardly seems fair to say you 
fulfilled your duty as a guide, though.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, you did a splendid job.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Keep up the good work just like that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So... what in the world is going on...

Even after that, Narita Brian continued to 
gain fans without even realizing it.
